_comment: The numbers this track rests on, each with where it came from and when. Counts only: no name, address or message
text from Leif's mail or Drive is ever written here. `npm run prove` fails while any fact lacks a source or a date,
and turns this into a NOTE once asOf is over 14 days old. A SUMMARY source means a search summary, page not opened.
